landing.heroPitch: ARShot turns your photos into 3D models and augmented reality — your customers see your products in their own home, from their phone, with no app.
landing.heroDemoHint: Drag to rotate · scroll to zoom
landing.heroQrHint: Point your phone camera at the code
landing.howStep1Desc: 1 to 4 photos of your product, shot with any smartphone. No studio, no gear.
landing.howStep2Desc: Our pipeline cuts out, reconstructs and optimizes the model for web and AR — in about 60 seconds.
landing.howStep3Desc: QR code, link, Shopify embed or Amazon export: customers see the product in AR without installing anything.
landing.featuresSubtitle: The ARShot toolkit, ready to use.
landing.feature1Desc: Upload your photos, AI produces a web-optimized GLB — background removal and optimization included.
landing.feature2Desc: One unique QR per product, with scan analytics by device and country.
landing.feature3Desc: A file meeting Amazon SP-3D specs to enable “View in 3D” on your listings.
landing.feature4Desc: iOS and Android open AR straight from the browser — no download required.
landing.feature5Desc: Embed the viewer on Shopify, WordPress or any site by copying a snippet.
landing.feature6Desc: Studio-grade product photos generated by AI from your 3D models.
landing.useCasesSubtitle: Wherever seeing the product changes the buying decision.
landing.useCase1Desc: Shopify and Amazon: enable 3D view on your product pages with one export.
landing.useCase1Stat: Amazon requires a GLB for “View in 3D”
landing.useCase2Desc: Your dishes in AR on the customer's table, from a QR on the menu.
landing.useCase2Stat: A menu you see before you order
landing.useCase3Desc: Customers project your creation in their home, at real scale.
landing.useCase3Stat: Up to -40% returns thanks to AR
landing.useCase4Desc: A QR on the box turns every sold product into an experience.
landing.useCase4Stat: Every parcel becomes a marketing channel
landing.pricingSubtitle: Start free, scale as you sell more.

landing.finalSubtitle: Free, no credit card. One photo is enough.
landing.arVideoTitle: Your customers see your products in their home. No app.
landing.arVideoSubtitle: They scan the QR code — the product appears in augmented reality, on their table, at real scale.
landing.arVideoCaption: Demo recorded in real conditions — looping rotation
landing.workshopTitle: A full workshop, not just a viewer
landing.workshopSubtitle: Under the hood: the complete chain, from photo to customer.
landing.tool1Desc: GLB compliant with Amazon's “View in 3D” specs, with automatic checks: triangles, textures, file weight.
landing.tool2Desc: Dynamic QR per product + scan analytics: who scans, from where, on which device.
landing.tool3Desc: Every model is measured automatically (polycount, texture resolution) — insufficient quality means regeneration.
landing.tool4Desc: Pipeline connected to several AI engines — you're never locked into one provider.
landing.tool5Desc: Quick Look (USDZ) on iPhone, Scene Viewer on Android — zero app to install.
landing.tool6Desc: Universal iframe, Shopify and WordPress/WooCommerce integration in one copy-paste.
